title: Collections Desk Guide: Delinquency Review Days on Retail Installment Contract Payoffs
content:
**Rule.** A borrower payoff of a contract under Retail Installment Contracts carries delinquency review days set by the installment due on the next due date, measured on the posting date:

- more than **10** days (the product's late-charge grace period) past due: **3** review days are added;
- past due but within its grace period (1 to 10 days): **1** review day is added;
- not past due (the next due date on or after the posting date): none are added.

| Days from the next due date to the posting date | Review days |
|---|---|
| 0 or fewer | none |
| 1 | 1 |
| 10 | 1 |
| 11 | 3 |
| 45 | 3 |

**Hypothetical case.** Next due date 14 April. A payoff posted 24 April is 10 days past due: 1 day. Posted 25 April, 11 days: 3 days. Posted 14 April: not past due, none.
